name: slack-channels-onboard
description: Give every Slack channel its own Kiro Crew agent, workspace and private memory. Detects channels the bot was added to, onboards them automatically or in one click, and lets you re-point the workspace, activation and thread follow from the dashboard.
author: mvn-bachhuynh-dn
highlights: Detects Slack channels the bot joined that have no agent yet
One bundle per channel: agent, workspace directory, private memory, channel binding
Auto, notify-only or manual onboarding, with an owner-in-channel guard
Edit workspace, activation and thread_follow per channel without touching config.json
Unbind channels the bot has left; agent, workspace and memory are kept
Members and per-channel maintainers, shown only when the gateway can enforce them
